name: Cambricon MLU370-X8 AIDC accelerator card product page
notes: PRIMARY VENDOR SOURCE. Full table: Cambricon MLUarch03, 7 nm, FP32 24 TFLOPS / FP16 96 TFLOPS / BF16 96 TFLOPS / INT16 128 TOPS / INT8 256 TOPS, LPDDR5 48 GB at 614.4 GB/s, PCIe Gen4 x16, MLU-Link 4 ports x 16 lanes @ 50 Gbps = 200 GB/s bidirectional aggregate, full-height full-length dual-slot, 250 W, passive. Vendor's own measured claim: single-card performance on four common models comparable to a 350 W RTX GPU, with better multi-card scaling at 8 cards.
